rows.reason: Single well-formed inline candidate, exact visible link text; broad example.com destination permits the observed subdomain. No alternative destination or fragment comparison.

Visible guidance names a document topic/domain but no exact destination; positives include distinct query/fragment destinations and assume these have the requested contents. The Markdown family excludes fragment-anchor reasoning. Do not infer a precise URL from candidates or treat potentially different sections/OS pages as interchangeable without visible permission.
